title: Unwound
description: Unwound is a trust-based, pure vanilla SMP with no land claims or shortcuts for a truly survival experience. We are a peaceful community of mature players looking for a quiet place to build and hang out after work.
body:
Are you tired of servers filled with teleport commands, claims, and pay-to-win features? Me too.

I created Unwound as a quiet place to log in after a long day, do some mining, and hang out with a mature community. We are a pure vanilla Java server running on Fabric with no land claims or protected zones.

The whole server runs entirely on trust. We respect each other's space, builds, and chests. It’s a return to that old-school Minecraft vibe where the community was the main protection.

We are a small group of players looking to find more mature people to join us. We play strictly in survival. To give everyone peace of mind, we have invisible logging tools so we can easily undo any griefing, though we’ve never had to use them.

[Discord](https://discord.gg/vYeudRGYMA) apply here
